title: Diane Brady (Fortune Executive Editorial Director) picks Incorruptible for Fortune CEO Daily summer beach reads
summary: Diane Brady — Fortune's Executive Editorial Director and CEO Daily editor — features Incorruptible as one of three summer business books she's taking to the beach, alongside Josh Tyrangiel's and Simon Paré-Poupart's picks, framing it as 'praise of the worthy business book' for Fortune's CEO audience.
blockquote: What do Josh Tyrangiel, Eric Ries and Simon Paré-Poupart have in common? They're ready to join you at the beach… In Fortune CEO Daily, I come in praise of the worthy business book.
attribution_title: Executive Editorial Director, Fortune; editor, Fortune CEO Daily
